name: Alhama de Aragón (Spain)
description: Divided by a broad blue wavy band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, red at the upper hoist and lower fly, charged with yellow towers in the red corners.
history: Municipal flag of Alhama de Aragón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad wavy band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
